name: Rape Onigokko
source:
Main character gets ordinary operation instructions from Noa, but devil changes the rules and makes protagonist tag three girls including Noa and violate them forever.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-april-2008-gouen-no-soleil.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角从诺亚那里得到了普通的操作指令，但恶魔却改变了规则，让主角标记了包括诺亚在内的三个女孩，并永远违反了她们的规定。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-april-2008-gouen-no-soleil.html]vndbreview[/url]]
